sources.name: 中国区 App Store 产品页

retrieval.responseHashScope: HttpClient response entity bytes after automatic gzip/deflate decompression

excerpt.normalization: Rendered visible text selected from the product page and expanded App Privacy dialog; UTF-8 with LF line endings

limitations: The App Store page is mutable and the response body can contain request-specific content.
The privacy label is developer-declared and not verified by Apple.
Third-party advertising data-use disclosure does not prove a visible ad placement or display frequency.

sources.name: 官方用户协议

retrieval.responseHashScope: Response entity bytes returned by HttpClient

excerpt.normalization: Exact English substrings selected from the UTF-8 response; blocks separated by one blank line; UTF-8 with LF line endings

limitations: The official endpoint is HTTP-only in this capture and provides no transport confidentiality or origin authentication.
The endpoint was intermittently available and returned 502 on later verification attempts.
The English body names the service CalScan while the Chinese body names it 自律茄子; their relationship is inferred only from the same official URL, the S01 link, and shared developer identity.
General advertising and knowledge-content clauses do not prove that corresponding visible modules exist in the current iOS app.

evidenceImpact.notes: This capture improves prospective reproducibility only. It does not recreate the complete 2026-07-31 source state and does not upgrade any pending evidence.
